name: R&D: Tyres & Thermal Management
author: Swofty
description: Adds a new career R&D department, Tyres & Thermal Management, alongside the stock four.

options.label: Render the 5th R&D box
options.description: Inject the Tyres & Thermal Management box into the career R&D > Performance department grid. Experimental; disable if the Performance page misbehaves.

options.label: Attach the Tyres upgrade tree
options.description: Resolve and log the per-save R&D upgrade container the Tyres (code-4 'fake') department reads, so its research tree can be populated. The upgrade rows (upgrade_department=Fake) ship in the database; this logs the exact container hash to finalise their placement.

options.label: Diagnose the 5th R&D box layout
options.description: Read-only: on the next R&D > Performance visit, log the department box grid's authored slot vector vs the card vector so the invisible-5th-box cause is captured. Produces no gameplay change.

options.label: Render the 5th development-potential pie slice
options.description: Grow the R&D > Performance development-potential pie to a 5th slice for Tyres & Thermal Management. Experimental and highest-risk: the pie wedge is authored art, so the slice is populated but no wedge draws yet. Default off; enable only to test.
